sources.title: Quantum Gravity Constraints from Unitarity and Analyticity

evidence.text: Which quadratic and quartic curvature corrections to Einstein gravity are compatible with unitarity and analyticity of four-graviton scattering in a perturbative ultraviolet completion?

sources.title: Positivity of Curvature-Squared Corrections in Gravity

evidence.text: What sign constraint does unitarity impose on the leading Gauss–Bonnet curvature-squared coefficient in pure gravity, when that operator is generated by a healthy tree-level ultraviolet completion?

sources.title: Unitary Issues in Some Higher Derivative Field Theories

evidence.text: Does eliminating ghost poles and improving ultraviolet behavior suffice for a higher-derivative theory to define a unitary fundamental quantum field theory? The paper tests this using Euclidean reflection positivity and spectral representations.

sources.title: Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet Gravity in Four-Dimensional Spacetime

evidence.text: Can rescaling the higher-dimensional Gauss-Bonnet coupling by 1/(D−4), followed by a continuous D→4 limit, define modified four-dimensional gravity while retaining covariance, second-order dynamics, and only massless graviton polarizations?

sources.title: Swampland conditions for higher derivative couplings from CFT

evidence.text: What dimension-dependent spectral factor enters the gravitational correction to the four-derivative scalar coupling bound?

sources.title: Causality, unitarity and stability in quantum gravity: a non-perturbative perspective

evidence.text: Which momentum dependence and singularity structures allow a dressed graviton propagator to satisfy non-perturbative unitarity, causality and stability while admitting analytic Wick rotation?

sources.title: Reflection positivity in a higher-derivative model with physical bound states of ghosts

evidence.text: Does the composite bound-state operator in a previously proposed six-derivative scalar ghost model satisfy two-point Osterwalder–Schrader reflection positivity and admit a renormalized Källén–Lehmann representation with nonnegative spectral density?

sources.title: The Phantom menaced: Constraints on low-energy effective ghosts

evidence.text: How low must the ultraviolet cutoff of a scalar ghost effective theory be to suppress observable vacuum instability, and can a Lorentz-invariant cutoff suffice?

sources.title: Causality Constrains Higher Curvature Corrections to Gravity

evidence.text: Which signs of four-dimensional quartic Riemann corrections avoid positive ultraviolet graviton group-velocity shifts, and do quadratic or cubic curvature corrections modify propagation in the same approximation?

sources.title: Quantum Gravity Constraints from Unitarity and Analyticity

evidence.text: Map polarization dependence to linear algebra. With H+={ε1,ε2}/2 and H−=i[ε1,ε2]/2, define x=(Tr H+)², y=Tr H+², z=Tr H−². The quartic bound is (2c6+c7)+(32c1+4c2+2c6)x+(8c2+16c3+8c4+2c6+2c7)y+(−16c3+8c4−2c6+2c7)z>0 for every physical polarization pair.

sources.title: Positivity of Curvature-Squared Corrections in Gravity

evidence.text: Matches the off-shell graviton two-point function at low momentum instead of computing full graviton scattering. This avoids dependence on interactions nonlinear in χ. The Weyl tensors are linearized in gravitons, and integrating out χ yields a spectral expression for λ.

sources.title: Unitary Issues in Some Higher Derivative Field Theories

evidence.text: The authors apply Osterwalder–Schrader reflection positivity and the requirement of a Källén–Lehmann representation with nonnegative spectral density. A negative reflected quadratic form would produce a negative norm in the standard Euclidean reconstruction.

sources.title: Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet Gravity in Four-Dimensional Spacetime

evidence.text: Vary the higher-dimensional action, rescale α, and evaluate the continuous dimensional limit at the level of equations of motion. Differential-form and ADM expressions are invoked as motivation for cancellation of dimension-dependent factors.

sources.title: Swampland conditions for higher derivative couplings from CFT

evidence.text: Replace c_a|σ|^a by c_a[1+i tan(πa/2)]σ^a on the lower-half-plane branch, preserving the real boundary value while allowing contour integration.

sources.title: Causality, unitarity and stability in quantum gravity: a non-perturbative perspective

evidence.text: Optical-theorem and spectral-density arguments; Cauchy decomposition into isolated poles and branch-cut contributions; contour Fourier transforms relating energy-plane singularities to propagation in time.

sources.title: Do we have unitary and (super)renormalizable quantum gravity below the Planck scale?

evidence.text: Does the presence of massive higher-derivative ghosts necessarily destabilise low-energy gravitational backgrounds, or does runaway behaviour depend on the initial perturbation frequency and background curvature scale?

sources.title: Perturbative unitarity of fractional field theories and gravity

evidence.text: Can fractional scalar, gauge and gravitational QFTs have perturbative unitarity compatible with ultraviolet renormalizability, and how do kinetic-operator definitions, Riemann-sheet choices and fakeon prescriptions affect their spectra and causality?

sources.title: Quantum Gravity, Fakeons And Microcausality

evidence.text: What do the one-loop absorptive self-energies and widths of the graviton multiplet imply about fakeon quantization, perturbative unitarity, and microcausality, and how do these results change when the spin-2 mode is quantized as a Stelle ghost?

sources.title: Multidimensional finite quantum gravity

evidence.text: Can a nonpolynomial higher-derivative completion of Einstein gravity retain the physical graviton spectrum, make higher-loop amplitudes convergent in arbitrary dimension, and eliminate the remaining one-loop divergences through covariant Pauli–Villars conditions?

sources.title: Bound states of massive complex ghosts in superrenormalizable quantum gravity theories

evidence.text: Can complex-conjugate massive ghost-like excitations form a normal composite with real mass and positive pole residue, providing a possible route toward stability in superrenormalizable gravity? The actual bound-state calculation uses a scalar toy model.

sources.title: Positive Signs in Massive Gravity

evidence.text: What restrictions do unitary, analytic graviton scattering amplitudes impose on ghost-free massive gravity, and can the full massive-spin-2 theory avoid the forward-positivity obstruction of its isolated Galileon limit?

sources.title: dS Spaces and Brane Worlds in Exotic String Theories

evidence.text: Can residual ghosts be removed geometrically or suppressed sufficiently to leave reliable low-energy gauge scattering?

sources.title: Consistent higher derivative gravitational theories with stable de Sitter and anti–de Sitter backgrounds

evidence.text: Which conditions on generally covariant higher-derivative metric actions ensure dS or AdS backgrounds with no ghost-like or tachyonic states in the perturbative spectrum, including actions with infinitely many derivatives?

sources.title: Recent Progress in Fighting Ghosts in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Under what conditions can higher-derivative quantum gravity reconcile renormalizability with unitarity and classical stability despite massive ghost states? The review emphasizes complex-pole Lee-Wick constructions and cosmological perturbation stability.

sources.title: Conformal Symmetry in Field Theory and in Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can higher-derivative or weakly nonlocal gravity achieve UV finiteness, unitarity and non-anomalous local conformal symmetry, and what further constraints does conformality impose on effective actions and scattering?

sources.title: Unitarity versus Renormalizability of Higher Derivative Gravity in 3D

evidence.text: Can three-dimensional gravity with quadratic curvature terms be both perturbatively renormalizable and unitary around Minkowski space, especially at the new-massive-gravity coefficient choice? The paper also examines why an earlier renormalizability argument may fail.

sources.title: Reconstructing the graviton

evidence.text: What Lorentzian spectral information can be reconstructed from Euclidean fluctuation and background graviton propagators in asymptotically safe gravity, and what can their different signs and normalizations imply about unitarity?

sources.title: Super-renormalizable Higher-Derivative Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can an infinite-derivative extension of quadratic gravity improve ultraviolet behavior while avoiding additional negative-residue propagator poles and rendering the point-source gravitational potential regular?

sources.title: Super-renormalizable Quantum Gravity

evidence.text: Can an infinite-derivative extension of quadratic gravity retain only the physical graviton pole, become perturbatively super-renormalizable, reproduce Einstein gravity in the infrared, and soften classical black-hole singularities?

sources.title: Unattainability of the trans-Planckian regime in nonlocal quantum gravity

evidence.text: Does ultraviolet asymptotic freedom in generalized nonlocal quantum gravity prevent accelerator access to trans-Planckian energies, hide microscopic causality violations, and suppress trans-Planckian corrections to inflationary perturbations?

sources.title: Self-Completeness of Einstein Gravity

evidence.text: Reproduces an earlier species-resolution argument: comparing an unknown label with N sample species requires energy at least N/L in the measurement region. Requiring this region to exceed its gravitational radius yields the species length.

sources.title: A Pedagogical explanation for the non-renormalizability of gravity

evidence.text: Dimensional analysis and extensivity give CFT thermal scaling. Black-hole horizon equations and the Bekenstein–Hawking area law give competing entropy–energy exponents; the argument compares those exponents rather than matching prefactors.

sources.title: Self-Completeness of Einstein Gravity
